view_frame: The drawing provides a TOP view in the XY plane and a FRONT view in the XZ plane. The X-axis represents width (horizontal in both views), the Y-axis represents depth (vertical in TOP view), and the Z-axis represents height/thickness (vertical in FRONT view). The part is a flat plate with constant thickness.

features.placement: Base profile lies in XY plane from (0,0) to (60,40). Extruded along Z from 0 to 6.
features.evidence: TOP view shows a 60x40 rectangle. FRONT view shows '6 thick'. Text states 'Same outline through full thickness'.

features.placement: Located at the top-right corner of the plate (X=60, Y=40). The corner is rounded with a radius of 6mm.
features.evidence: TOP view shows a rounded corner at top-right. Text annotation: 'Top-right corner R6 only'.

features.placement: Centred on the top edge (Y=40). Width 20mm (X from 20 to 40). Depth 10mm (Y from 30 to 40).
features.evidence: TOP view shows a rectangular cutout on the top edge. Text annotation: 'Notch: 20 wide x 10 deep', 'Notch centred on top edge'.

features.placement: Centre at X=12, Y=15. Through all Z (0 to 6).
features.evidence: TOP view shows a circle. Text annotation: 'Ø8 THROUGH', 'Hole centre: 12 from left edge, 15 from bottom edge'.

connections: The notch is a subtraction from the top edge of the plate body.
The top-right corner rounding modifies the corner of the plate body.
The through hole is a subtraction through the plate body.
edit_rules: Changing plate width (X) or depth (Y) requires updating the notch position (centred on top edge) and hole position (relative to left/bottom edges).
Changing plate thickness (Z) does not affect the XY profile.
Changing notch width requires re-centring it on the top edge.
Changing hole diameter does not affect its centre location.
